extracted.name: Zafarani Gulab jamun
extracted.description: memories enlighten events yummy gulab jamun for eid #myfirstrecipe #cpl #zafran #referbycheffrom_uae
instruction_lines: Check out all ingredients ready to cook

Make sugar syrup Boil water,add sugar,let it dissolve completely.keep simmering at low flame for quite some time till syrup starts to bit thicken(no need for very thick syrup).turn off heat and add lemon juice and pinch of saffron, Keep aside
Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl.beat egg and melt ghee.knead a soft dough.cover it and keep for least 1/2 hour
Make medium round balls from dough.keep in an opn tray covered under damp cloth for 15-20 mins. Then deep fry in oil till golden
Dip balls in sugar syrup. Then take out. Sprinkle almonds nuts slivers on top
Enjoy homemade national sweet of Pakistan and enjoy Eid.
